Employee desktop, Direction B

Every Employee page at 1440px (Home also at 1280px) in the Owner desktop system that is built: the off-white sidebar with the Employee’s entries, the flat teal top bar with search, alerts and account, the teal band holding each page’s title, and white cards that lift over it.

Same information as the approved Employee phone pages, laid out for a wide screen. Fictional data: James Ortiz, Front counter at Calle Loíza, Northside Café & Bakery, Saturday, Nov 7. Use Today to compare with the current desktop page, and Full size to see a frame at 100%. Nothing is built; this is the mock to approve first.

  • One shellThe Owner’s built sidebar and top bar. Employee entries: Home, Schedule, Time, Pay, Requests, then More: Updates and Notifications (with its unread count).
  • Main screens liftHome, Schedule, Time, Pay and Requests have the taller band; the first cards lift 52px over it. Pay uses the dark ink band.
  • Two columns where it helpsLists sit beside their detail (Past timecards, swaps for you), and reading pages keep an 812px column.
  • Data rulesPay statements show no amounts. No coworker details beyond what the pages show today. No figures the app doesn’t have.

Delete account

Your NEVORA sign-in, not your job

What we delete

Your access ends right awayYou’re signed out on every device and can’t sign in again with your password or a passkey. Calendar feed links and device alerts stop.
Deleted within 30 calendar days after we receive the requestWe aim to delete your profile, sign-in details, notification subscriptions, calendar links and the content you contributed. After you confirm, you can’t cancel it in the app.

What Northside Café & Bakery keeps

Deleting your NEVORA account doesn’t end your employment or remove records your employer has to keep.
